# Our Big Family Move To Denver

## Key Takeaways For Everyone

We are moving to Denver in March and the house goes on the market next week. The movers come on the second Friday of the month and they will pack the kitchen first. The kids will finish the school year here and start at the new school in the fall. My mom will stay with us for the first two weeks to help with the boxes and the dog. The new house has a big yard and a garage with room for both of the bikes. We will host a small goodbye dinner at our place on the last Sunday before the trip. Please bring a dish if you can and plan to stay late with us that night.

**Important:** the dinner starts at six. **Parking** is on the street. **Gifts** are not needed at all.

This next part is a very long sentence that keeps going because we wanted to thank every single neighbor on the block for the years of borrowed ladders and shared tomatoes and late night chats on the porch and all of the times you watched the dog when we were away for work or family trips or long weekends at the lake.

We will miss you all so much! Thank you again! See you soon! Love you!

Our movers were booked by the company and the final bill was paid by my dad. Many friends said the plan was really smart and several neighbors said it was incredibly brave. We want to circle back with everyone going forward and touch base before the move. A lot of people said the timing was significant.
